title: Communities
description: Communities in Sandy City, Utah. 30 multipolygon features, mirrored as GeoParquet in EPSG:3566 (NAD83(HARN) / Utah Central (ftUS)) with Web Mercator vector tiles for display. See the [agent guide](AGENTS.md) for the schema, the coded-value lists and queries that run.

links.title: Sandy City, Utah — Municipal Open Data
Sandy City GIS, the publisher of this layer
Licence status: Sandy City states no licence

table:columns.name: OBJECTID
table:columns.description: Esri object identifier. A row number assigned by the source geodatabase and reassigned when the layer is republished. It is not a stable key and must not be used to join across collections or across refreshes.

table:columns.name: COMMUNITY_ID
table:columns.description: Sandy community area number, joining to the `communities` collection. Measured in the published file: Populated on 100% of 30 rows, 30 distinct values, ranging 1 to 30.

table:columns.name: COMMUNITY_NAME
table:columns.description: Name of the community area. Some rows carry a number rather than a name.

table:columns.name: LEADER_NAME
table:columns.description: Community council chair. Contact details for this person were removed before publication; see the README.

table:columns.name: Color
table:columns.description: Cartographic fill index used so that neighbouring areas differ on the city's own maps. It carries no meaning about the area.

table:columns.name: EMERGENCY_PREPAREDNESS_LEADER
table:columns.description: Sandy City publishes no definition for this column, and the source layer declares no coded-value domain for it. Measured in the published file: Populated on 40% of 30 rows, 12 distinct values.

table:columns.name: EMERGENCY_PREPAREDNESS_LEADER2
table:columns.description: Sandy City publishes no definition for this column, and the source layer declares no coded-value domain for it. Measured in the published file: Populated on 17% of 30 rows, 5 distinct values.

table:columns.name: LINK
table:columns.description: Link to a page about this feature on a city or partner website.

table:columns.name: Sandy_HH
table:columns.description: Sandy City publishes no definition for this column, and the source layer declares no coded-value domain for it. Measured in the published file: Populated on 100% of 30 rows, 30 distinct values, ranging 0 to 2497.

table:columns.name: Unicorp_HH
table:columns.description: Sandy City publishes no definition for this column, and the source layer declares no coded-value domain for it. Measured in the published file: Populated on 100% of 30 rows, 18 distinct values, ranging 0 to 938.

table:columns.name: Sandy_Pop
table:columns.description: Population within the Sandy city limit.

table:columns.name: Unicorp_Pop
table:columns.description: Population in the unincorporated part of the community area.

table:columns.name: Total_HH
table:columns.description: Total households in the community area.

table:columns.name: Total_Pop
table:columns.description: Total population of the community area. Ranges 661 to 7,084 across the 30 areas.

table:columns.name: Date_Updated
table:columns.description: Sandy City publishes no definition for this column, and the source layer declares no coded-value domain for it. Measured in the published file: Populated on 100% of 30 rows, 1 distinct values.

table:columns.name: Sandy_PPH
table:columns.description: Sandy City publishes no definition for this column, and the source layer declares no coded-value domain for it. Measured in the published file: Populated on 97% of 30 rows, 29 distinct values, ranging 2.06286 to 3.33391.

table:columns.name: Unincorp_PPH
table:columns.description: Sandy City publishes no definition for this column, and the source layer declares no coded-value domain for it. Measured in the published file: Populated on 60% of 30 rows, 17 distinct values, ranging 2 to 4.

table:columns.name: Total_PPH
table:columns.description: Average persons per household, derived by the city from the population and household counts.

table:columns.name: Shape.area
table:columns.description: Polygon area computed by the geodatabase, in the square units of the source coordinate system. Recompute it from the geometry rather than trusting it, because it is not updated when a shape is edited.

table:columns.name: Shape.len
table:columns.description: Line length or polygon perimeter computed by the geodatabase, in the units of the source coordinate system. Recompute it from the geometry rather than trusting it.

table:columns.name: geometry
table:columns.description: Feature geometry, WKB encoded, in the collection's `proj:epsg` coordinate system.

table:columns.name: bbox
table:columns.type: struct<xmin: double, ymin: double, xmax: double, ymax: double>
table:columns.description: Per-row bounding box written by gpio, as a struct of `xmin`, `ymin`, `xmax`, `ymax`, in the same coordinate system as the geometry. Rows are in Hilbert order, so filtering on this column prunes row groups efficiently.
